name: Camp Souhegan
operator_name: Boys & Girls Club of Souhegan Valley
description_short: Boys & Girls Club summer day camp at the Club in Milford for youth in kindergarten to grade 10, by the week or the day for ten weeks. Each week has a theme and field trips, with outdoor play and swimming at Keyes Pool; drop off from 7:00, program 9:00 to 3:30, pick up by 6:00.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations must be made at least 2 weeks in advance; transfers to another week are allowed if there is space.
swim_waterfront_notes: Free swim and swim lessons through the Club's partnership with Keyes Pool.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 Camp Souhegan: ten weeks June 15 to August 21, closed Friday July 3; $300 a week or $75 a day; weekly dates derived as Monday to Friday; grades K to 10, ages derived from grades (age_min = grade_min + 5, age_max = grade_max + 6), rising kindergarteners must be at least 4 years 8 months; drop off 7:00 and pick up by 6:00 around a 9:00 to 3:30 program
ZIP looked up with the Census Bureau geocoder from the address on the camp's page (56 MONT VERNON RD, MILFORD, NH, 03055)

source.title: Summer Camp | Souhegan Valley Boys & Girls Club

warnings: These are 2026 dates and prices; 2027 is not posted.
The page calls the camp Camp Souhegan; the discovery name was Souhegan Valley Boys & Girls Club Summer Camp.
Hours 7:00 to 6:00 include care around the 9:00 to 3:30 program, so extended_care is true. The page does not say whether a club membership fee applies.
Week 3 is four days because of July 3; no price is posted for the short week.
